outputs: Generated title paraphrases derived from document abstracts

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate 'GPT2' entry and normalized to 'GPT-2'. Simplified output description to match paper terminology.
Paper uses IR metrics (P@5, NDCG@10, MAP@1000) for retrieval evaluation, but no automatic metrics for evaluating the generated paraphrases themselves.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation mentioned in the paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs mentioned in the paper.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on document retrieval using weakly-supervised methods. While it does generate paraphrases using GPT-2, the main evaluation focuses on retrieval performance rather than the quality of the generated paraphrases themselves. The paper does not evaluate the NLG outputs using traditional NLG metrics or human evaluation.
